state.errorBody: The data could not be loaded. Try again.

home.description: Operational overview of clients, projects and processes in the workspace.

models.description: Every BPMN diagram of the active processes, with the state of the diagram, the review and the comparison with the sources.

empty.title: No models yet
empty.description: Every process has its own model: create a project and a process, then reconstruct it from the sources.

noResults.title: No models found
noResults.description: No model matches the search or filters.

archive.description: Closed clients, projects and processes. Still readable, and reopenable.
archive.empty: Nothing archived: everything you opened is still work in progress.

archive.title: Archive {{kind}}
archive.description: "{{name}}" leaves the working lists and stays readable in the Archive. You can reopen it any time.
archive.reasonHint: Optional, but it is what tells "finished" from "never went anywhere" when you read it back in a year.

restore.title: Reopen {{kind}}
restore.description: "{{name}}" returns to the working lists, along with what was closed with it.

delete.title: Delete {{kind}}
delete.description: "{{name}}" is permanently deleted, with everything that depends on it.
delete.confirmHint: It is there so the wrong record cannot be deleted by accident.
delete.nameMismatch: The name does not match: nothing was deleted.
delete.warning: This cannot be undone. If you only need it out of your current work, archive it instead.

serviceStatus.title: Service status
serviceStatus.description: Where the product talks, whether the backend answers, and what work is queued.
serviceStatus.healthy: The backend answers, no fallback active.
serviceStatus.degraded: The backend answers, but something came back through a fallback path.
serviceStatus.queuesNotConfigured: Queues are not configured in this environment.
serviceStatus.deadLetter: {{count}} set aside: they will not pass on their own.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Changes the whole interface immediately and stays chosen next time on this browser.

help.title: Help
help.description: How an engagement moves forward in DeliR, and what to do when something does not respond.

project.title: Create the project
project.body: One project per client and engagement: it holds processes, sources and decisions.

sources.title: Add the sources
sources.body: Interviews, notes and process documents. The model is built only from what is on record.

reconstruct.title: Reconstruct the process
reconstruct.body: From the process chat DeliR drafts a plan and a BPMN diagram from the sources.

gaps.title: Close the gaps
gaps.body: Open questions come from contradictions or silences in the sources: answer them or pick one of the proposed alternatives.

validate.title: Validate the model
validate.body: Compare the diagram with the sources and approve the review when no blocking points remain.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.answer: Pick an alternative in an open question
shortcuts.search: Move through and open history search results
shortcuts.close: Close the history or the side panel
shortcuts.resize: Resize a panel from its divider

trouble.title: Something not responding?
trouble.body: Before retrying, check whether the backend answers and has queued work: knowledge that does not arrive is often a stalled queue, not a wrong answer.

search.title: Search the workspace
search.description: Clients, projects, processes and sources. Type a name and open what you need.

empty.title: No notifications
empty.description: When a plan, a comparison or a simulation finishes, you will find it here.

kind.conformance_findings_one: {{count}} point to review in the comparison with the sources
kind.conformance_findings_other: {{count}} points to review in the comparison with the sources

identity.workspaceHint: The workspace the data you are seeing belongs to.
identity.noPersonYet: The product does not know who you are yet: per-person sign-in comes with authentication.

section.title: Access
section.description: How this environment recognises who uses it.
section.adminYes: Yes: this session can delete and archive
section.pending: Per-person identity — who validated a model, who answered a question — comes with real authentication. Until then every action is recorded as the workspace, not as someone.
section.failed: The access state could not be read.
